features.title: 광안 메디컬 의원 facility layer: working doors, real restrooms, elevator 1F/2F/R, fire exit, ER entrance, STAFF/창고 rooms, rooftop garden (HospitalPlus)
features.extra:
## EXCEPTIONS for this feature (override the generic rules above)
- This is a CLIENT-ONLY layer inside the existing LocalScript folder src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/GwangalliBuildingInterior/. Your ONLY allowed files are HospitalPlus.luau and new Hosp_*.luau there (require siblings with require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Hosp_X"))). Do not edit any other file in that folder (T_clinic.luau is being written by another agent; Kit/Look/Props/Interact/Scan/init are shared) — if you need a shared change, put the exact diff in your final answer.
- Addon hook already exists in init.client.luau: a ModuleScript named HospitalPlus is required at startup and HospitalPlus.start(ctx) is called with ctx = { root (Folder Workspace.GwInteriorDetailLocal), focus() -> Vector3?, limits() -> (maxVenues, maxParts, maxLights), dbg, script, Scan }. Register world keep-zones synchronously at module top level with Scan.addWorldKeep(minWorld, maxWorld, kind) (require Scan via script.Parent) so T_clinic and other room builders keep those spaces clear.
- Reuse Kit.luau / Look.luau / Props.luau / Interact.luau helpers (read them) so the style matches the rest of the interiors. Real rooms you build may be CanCollide=true locally (the local character is client-simulated); everything else Anchored, no query/touch. Map is read-only: hide fake doors locally with Scan.hide and draw your own leaves.
- Owner's request (Korean): "병원도 내부 구현해 나갈수 있는 문이랑 등등 다 구현해서 AAA급 시설 퀄리티".
- Survey: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user--/70cfab65-8cfb-5029-bbdf-07c69ae89ee1/scratchpad/bld/hospital_garage.json (hospital contracts: HospitalPrompt anchors, HospitalBed seats, HospitalStaff rigs, NPC SPOT corridors, AutoDoor_Hospital). Offline preview pipeline: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user--/70cfab65-8cfb-5029-bbdf-07c69ae89ee1/scratchpad/bprev (hospital fixtures, sim.luau, preview.js; renders share a 3-slot semaphore). Studio: /home/user/-/tools/build_studio_cabin.py with env BLD_SRC = the building interior folder builds a studio HTML with the building interior injected.
features.build: Implement the design doc fully: in-place 남/여 화장실 at the west end of the 1F back hall (stalls with lockable doors 사용중/비어있음, urinals + dividers, vanity sinks + mirrors, soap/towel/hand dryer, diaper station, motion-sensor light; interactions flush / wash hands / dryer), real working elevator (call buttons, floor indicator, chime, sliding doors, portal cabin with 1·2·R buttons, ride; NEW 2F door on the checkup back wall; roof stop at the penthouse), portal rooms for STAFF ONLY 직원 휴게실 (lockers, sofa, kitchenette, notice board) and 창고 (labelled supply shelves, linen cart, wheelchairs, O2 cylinders) at a proven-empty hidden location, through-wall 비상구 (push bar, outside landing, re-entry) and new 응급실 출입구 on the east wall into the treatment room with an EMERGENCY light box, glass room doors (Door_*) that open on approach + '진료 중' lamp, rooftop garden (deck, planters, benches, pergola string lights, safety rails, 광안대교 망원경), wayfinding (비상구 유도등, 층별 안내, floor numbers, name plates). Fade overlay + Korean toasts; prompts via Interact.prompt (R / ButtonY). Lazy build within ~140 studs of (-515,7,300); budgets per the doc; cleanup on leave; never block NPC corridors, beds, prompts, stairs.

features.title: 팡팡노래방-style karaoke (GwangalliKaraokePlus)
features.build:
Owner asked: "팡팡노래방 로블 마냥 노래방 형식으로 만들수도 있음?" → build it on the existing coin karaoke booths per the design doc.
- Shared: config + song book (≥ 40 songs, TJ-style 5-digit numbers, title/artist/genre/BPM/key/duration, beat-timed lyric lines for the colour wipe, note data for melody/bass/chords/drums). CONTENT RULE: only public-domain (traditional Korean folk, PD melodies) or ORIGINAL songs with fictional artists; never real copyrighted lyrics. Optional per-song SoundId for licensed tracks.
- Client sequencer synced to server start time (workspace:GetServerTimeNow()), pitch via PlaybackSpeed on a small pool of samples (sound ids already used in the place or built-in rbxasset sounds, configurable), tempo/key ±, guide melody on/off, volume.
- Booth flow reusing the existing payment/rental; 리모컨 UI (number pad, search, 인기차트/신곡/장르, shared 예약 queue up to 20, 우선예약, 취소, 시작/정지/처음부터, tempo/key/volume/echo/guide), effects (탬버린, 박수, 환호, 폭죽, 꽃가루) for everyone in the booth with rate limits.
- TV (SurfaceGui in PlayerGui adorned to the booth TV): intro card, countdown, two-line lyrics with colour wipe, 간주중, genre backgrounds, next-song ticker, end score screen with 100점 celebration, idle screen.
- Mic echo via the new audio API when available (server rewires AudioDeviceInput → echo/reverb → emitter in the booth and restores on leave), graceful Korean hint otherwise; scoring by voice activity if available else a rhythm tap mini-game; cosmetic scores, optional small capped reward via the existing money API.
- Booth light show, server-authoritative booth state, validation, cleanup; one sequencer per client; mobile-friendly Korean UI.

features.title: CLUB OCEAN 광안 AAA show: 전광판 order/후원 animations with nicknames, ranking boards, laser show, DJ mode, 합석 production (GwangalliClubPlus)
features.build:
Owner's request (Korean, with a screenshot of a Korean Roblox club: purple laser fans across the hall, neon DJ booth): "클럽도 실제 클럽 맹키로 AAA급으로 이런식으로 연출과, 술같은 음료 시키면 가운데 전광판에 애니메이션에 술 시킨 사람과 후원도 하면 똑같이 닉네임을 보여주면서 후원이나 술 가격 랭킹전같은 옆 전광판에도 달아주고, 거기다가 술 같은 음료 시키면 부킹 연출등 화려하면서 재밌게". Augment (never break/duplicate) the existing club systems per the design doc:
1) centre LED wall: idle VJ loops synced to BPM + event takeovers for drink/bottle orders (orderer DisplayName + @name, table, item, price; tiers 일반/프리미엄/VIP/레전드 with escalating animation + world cues: laser colour flash, LED floor ripple, CO2, confetti, parade intensity) and for 후원 (amount + optional message filtered via TextService broadcast filtering), queued.
2) 후원 with in-game money (presets + custom, validated, rate-limited); optional Robux developer products from config (empty = hidden); install ProcessReceipt only if none exists, plus an exported handler; idempotent receipts.
3) side LED ranking boards: 오늘의 큰손 TOP 5, 후원 랭킹 TOP 5, 최고가 주문, 이번 주 랭킹 (OrderedDataStore with retries + memory fallback, KST day/week keys), ticker, rank-change animation, crown nameplate for #1.
4) show upgrade like the screenshot: laser fans/beams, moving heads, strobes, LED floor patterns, haze, CO2, confetti cannons, mirror ball, DJ booth glow — client-side, synced to a server timeline/BPM, layered with ClubLights (don't fight it), quality tiers, only inside the club.
5) DJ mode: one DJ at a time (queue, 3-min turns, admin config), DJ pad (레이저 쇼, CO2, 폭죽, 스트로브, filtered LED text) with cooldowns, 'DJ ○○ ON AIR'.
6) 부킹 연출 layered on the existing all-ages 합석 이벤트: spotlight on MD/guests walking to the table, LED card 'TABLE 12 · 합석 이벤트!', sparkle trail, confetti on 짠. Roblox policy: all-ages social framing only (no dating/romance wording or hearts), drinks are 음료 (non-alcoholic names/visuals) consistent with the existing menu.
7) table number LED signs with current orderer, bottle presenter boards, bartender flair.
Server-authoritative, validated, rate-limited, efficient replication; Korean UI; mobile-friendly.

features.build:
Owner's request (Korean): "차량 판매 하는곳에는 npc한테 얘기하면 전체 차 종류별로 보이는 ui 보이게 만들어서 차량 구매할수있는 방식으로".
- Sales NPC: existing GarageStaff rig(s) (and other dealers) get '딜러와 상담하기'; greeting dialog with typing effect; choices 전체 차량 보기 / 이달의 특가 / 내 차 팔기·보상판매 (only if supported) / 시승 예약 / 그냥 둘러볼게요. Mark handled rigs with attribute GwDealerNpc=true.
- Catalog UI like a real brand configurator: tabs by type (전체 · 경차 · 세단 · SUV · 승합/밴 · 트럭 · 스포츠 · 전기차 · 특수차 … from real data), brand filter, sort, search; cards (name, brand, price in 만원, badges NEW/특가/보유중/레벨 제한); detail page with a ViewportFrame 3D preview of the real model (auto-rotate, drag, zoom, studio backdrop), colours if supported, specs from real data, owned/level checks, 시승하기 (existing testdrive), 구매하기 with confirmation (balance before/after), optional 비교하기.
- Purchase through the EXISTING ownership/money systems (only if none exists, a minimal saved store integrated with the spawn system), validated, idempotent, rate-limited; delivery ceremony (reuse the existing one if present) and tell how to call the car.
- Performance (clone previews on demand, strip scripts/sounds/lights, small cache), mobile bottom sheet layout, gamepad navigation, premium dark-glass Korean UI. Never break the garage contract (prompts, PriceCards, turntables, zones, lifts, wash, staff poses).

features.title: 내 집 마련 creative interior decorating (GwangalliDecorPlus)
features.build:
Owner asked: "내 집 마련 인테리어 기능도 재밌고 유저들이 창의적으로 할수있게 만들어줘". Implement the design doc (a partial shared catalog already exists under src/ReplicatedStorage/GwangalliDecorShared — continue it):
- Free-placement 인테리어 모드 coexisting with the existing slot furniture: grid snap (끄기/0.25/0.5/1), rotation 15°/45°/90° + fine, raise/lower, stacking on top surfaces, wall/ceiling mounting, move/rotate/duplicate/delete, undo/redo, multi-select + group move, valid/invalid ghost with optional 겹치기 허용, item info card; PC keys (R/T, Q/E, G, Ctrl+Z/Y, Delete, Ctrl+D), mobile touch drag + buttons, gamepad.
- Catalog ≥ 150 procedurally built real-world detailed items across 거실, 침실, 주방, 욕실, 조명, 식물, 벽장식, 가전/전자, 러그·카펫, 수납, 취미/게임, 베란다, 시즌/파티, 아이/펫 with price, size, placement type, colour slots (curated palette + HSV picker), material options; interactive items (lamps, TV channels, speaker, fireplace, curtains/blinds, aquarium, seats/beds, fridge/wardrobe doors).
- Room finishing (wall paint/wallpaper patterns, floors, lighting presets 따뜻한/주광/무드/네온/파티) coordinated with the existing theme system.
- Save/Load: 3 layout slots, compact serialization relative to UnitRoot, server validation (owner only, inside home bounds, cap ~300, purchases via the existing money API), existing profile system if possible else own DataStore with retries + fallback; reload on home re-creation.
- 집들이 likes + filtered 방명록, 사진 모드, 인테리어 점수/뱃지 and simple goals.
- Placed items in Folder "DecorPlus" under the home model (Models with ItemId/DecorUid attributes + tag GwDecorItem), anchored, collidable where sensible. Korean UI, mobile-friendly, AAA polish.

features.title: Shop NPC crew: interactable staff + table serving (GwangalliShopCrew)
features.build:
Owner asked: "각 가게 npc들도 상호작용 할수있게 배치 추가작으로 서빙등 해줄수있게". Implement the design doc (partial shared modules exist under src/ReplicatedStorage/GwangalliShopCrewShared — continue them):
- Staff at real posts per shop type (계산원, 바리스타, 요리사, 홀 서버, 약사, 미용사, 편의점 알바, PC방/노래방 카운터, 호프 사장님 ...) — augment existing staff NPCs where they exist, otherwise rigs with the place's NPC looks + per-type uniforms; idle work loops with simple animations.
- Interactions (prompt + dialog UI with name tag): 대화 (contextual lines, returning players), 메뉴 보기 (real shop data), 주문하기 → 결제 via the existing money API, 포장/매장, 팁, 칭찬/항의, 길 묻기.
- Table service: seated player → server walks over (pathfinding in the shop), takes the order, kitchen cooks (timer + fx), server carries a tray with procedurally built food and places it on the table; 먹기 (ties into hunger/health if present), 추가 주문, 계산; clearing dishes; same loop for ShopLife NPC customers if they sit.
- Respect players on shift (Jobs/WorkPlacement): NPC steps aside; never block job flows, prompts, doors, aisles. Skip rigs with attribute GwDealerNpc=true (handled by the dealership add-on).
- Activation radius, NPC caps, server-authoritative state matching how existing NPCs work; models in Workspace.GwShopCrew tagged GwShopNpc; tray/food non-collidable; cleanup. Korean UI, mobile-friendly, speech bubbles, order ticket, receipt.
